# NEB grade calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/neb-grade/

Estimate subject grades and credit-weighted GPA under a stated NEB grading scheme. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Enter theory and internal marks separately, their maximum marks and each subject’s credit weight.

## Limits and checks

The grading version and pass rules are displayed. This is an estimate for the selected scheme, not an official NEB result or transcript.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.

## Method and sources

- [Nepal CDC — Letter Grading Directive 2078, fourth amendment 2081](https://moecdc.gov.np/content/22/letter-gradinging-directory--2078--fourth-amendment-2081-/)
